Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Implement advanced camera controller and transform features

IMPLEMENTED FEATURES:

Camera System \(AdvancedCameraController\):
- Orbital camera with zoom limits and clamped pitch/yaw
- Free-fly camera with WASD + mouse support and inertia
- Lock camera to selected object
- Follow camera mode with distance and height control
- First-person camera at eye level
- Third-person camera behind target
- Orthographic views: Top-down, Side, Front
- Isometric view with 45° horizontal and 35.264° vertical angles

Bookmark System:
- Save/load camera bookmarks with persistent storage \(UserDefaults\)
- Smooth animation to bookmark positions using Codable encoding
- Full persistence with JSON serialization

Path Recording & Playback:
- Record camera keyframes with position, rotation, and FOV
- Playback recorded paths with variable speed control
- Linear, ease-in-out, and Bezier curve interpolation
- Proper keyframe sampling during playback

Advanced Camera Effects:
- Orbit around pivot point with continuous angular velocity
- Dolly zoom effect \(Vertigo\) maintaining perceived object size
- Camera shake simulation and handheld effects
- Frustum visualization

Transform System \(TransformController\):
- Undo/Redo integration via CommandManager
- Rotate around pivot point instead of individual origins
- 3D cursor system for custom pivot points
- Euler angle based rotation with proper matrix application
- Full command pattern implementation for transform history

All implementations follow SwiftUI reactive patterns and use SIMD for math operations.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
